q: Does the description state the situations in which this tool should be used?
Does it state at least one situation in which this tool should NOT be used?
Does it state how this tool differs from another tool with a similar purpose?
For every identifier parameter, does it give the expected format or an example value?
For every parameter with a limited set of allowed values, does it list those values?
Does it say which parameters are required and which are optional?
Does it state a rule that links two or more parameters (for example lists that must have equal length, or one parameter that only applies with another)?
Does it state a precondition on the object the parameters refer to (for example that an order must be pending)?
Does it say what happens when parameter values are inconsistent with each other or with the object's state?
Does it say where the value of at least one parameter comes from (another tool or source)?
Does it name a tool that is typically used before or after this one?
Does it name an alternative tool to use when this tool does not apply?
Does it say what the tool returns?
Does it say what the tool does not return, or what side effects it has?
Does it say what error or result occurs when the input is invalid or the object is not found?
